summary.text: Jackie Hayes is a Democratic member of the South Carolina House of Representatives, representing District 55, who assumed office in 1998 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia says he is also known as Coach and has been an athletic director and football coach since 1987.

paragraphs.text: Hayes earned a B.A. from Catawba College in 1984 and has been an athletic director and football coach since 1987, according to Ballotpedia.
He first assumed office in the South Carolina House in 1998, and Ballotpedia lists him on the House Rules Committee and the Ways and Means Committee for the 2025-2026 session.
